verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a custom HTML editor with live preview and an API for drafting and sending campaigns. Neither documents API-managed templates, uploading HTML or MJML from code, variable substitution, or a version-control workflow. The HTML editor is a UI feature and the campaign API is an adjacent capability, so neither delivers templates-as-code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control
